points.tip: Tip: 7 / 30 / 100-day streaks unlock achievement tasks with big point rewards. Chatting, posting, commenting, liking, bookmarking and messaging all earn points — go collect some and trade them for cosmetics!
points.shop_note: Note: cosmetics (titles / badges / bubbles / effects) — only one of each type can be equipped at a time, equipping a new one replaces the old. Effects wrap your chat avatar and do not change bubble styles. Items are single-use: they go to your bag after purchase and are used from their card.

ai.redeem_hint: Enter a code to top up your AI Hub balance
ai.doc_intro: AI Hub is MONO's own AI chat front end, backed by several model providers. This page explains models, pricing, billing and balance.
ai.doc_s1_p1: Prices here follow each provider's official rates exactly — no markup.
ai.doc_s1_p2: The input / output prices configured in the admin panel are the provider's published unit prices, in
ai.doc_s1_p3: — the same basis as official billing.
ai.doc_input_note: — what you send (question, conversation context) is billed per token
ai.doc_output_note: — what the model generates is billed per token (usually dearer than input)
ai.doc_price_hint: Prices differ per model — hover a model in the picker to see them
ai.doc_formula: (input tokens ÷ 1M) × input price + (output tokens ÷ 1M) × output price
ai.doc_s2_p2: Every reply shows “this reply: ¥0.xxxx” — the exact cost of that turn
ai.doc_s2_p3: Billing settles once the reply finishes; stopping early still charges for what was generated
ai.doc_s2_p4: Without enough balance you can't use paid models — you'll be prompted to top up. Free models are unaffected.
ai.doc_s3_p2: — enough to try things out for a while.
ai.doc_s3_p4: — open Account, hit “Redeem code” and enter a code from the admins
ai.doc_s3_p5: Balance is rounded down to the cent (¥0.0967 shows as ¥0.09) — never inflated
ai.doc_s3_p6: The pie chart under Account breaks your spending down by model — only your own chats
ai.doc_s4_p1: The list on the left holds your conversations; each is saved separately and survives refreshes and device changes
ai.doc_s4_p2: Each conversation remembers its own model
ai.doc_s4_p3: — switching back switches the model too.
ai.doc_s4_p4: Titles come from your first question; hit × to delete (cannot be undone)
ai.doc_s4_p5: Only you can see your conversations
ai.faq_q1: Q: Why is the price the same as the official site?
ai.faq_a1: A: Because that is the official price. The community adds nothing and takes no cut — we only relay requests and keep the books.
ai.faq_q2: Q: Am I charged if I stop the generation?
ai.faq_a2: A: Yes. What was generated already consumed tokens, so you pay for actual usage.
ai.faq_q3: Q: Can I withdraw the balance?
ai.faq_a3: A: No. The balance only pays for AI Hub usage here; it is not a stored-value account.
ai.faq_q4: Q: Where do redeem codes come from?
ai.faq_a4: A: The team hands them out from time to time — during events, as compensation, and so on.
ai.doc_footer: This guide is updated as features change. Questions? Post in the forum.
